Q.13 · The Loaded Die · proposed replacement for count-the-F's

Fully playable, v5. The die is now a real 3D render (three.js): a rounded ivory die with proper lighting and inset oxblood pips, drawn on a transparent canvas floating over the exam paper. Mechanics unchanged: ROLL tumbles it, but rolls are rigged (4, 2, 5, 3, then 1 forever) and always land with the 6 turned away out of sight. Grab the die and turn it freely like a trackball; release and it settles onto the nearest face, with the FACE UP register underneath stating what counts. No roll can ever land a 6; the only way is turning it up yourself. The first grab triggers the examiner's objection, which is also the hint. Rolling and turning cost nothing; futility is the punishment. Answer stays 6, preserving the Q49 lock code. Fully self-contained: three.js is vendored locally in mocks/vendor, so this works offline.
